summary: Specifies how Deterministic Networking (DetNet) service works for IP traffic on IP hosts and routers. No new DetNet header is defined for IP flows. Instead, existing IP and higher-layer header information is used to identify flows and deliver the service.

eli5.summary: This shows how to give some IP traffic a reserved fast lane without adding a special label, by recognizing the traffic from the address information it already carries.

questions: how does detnet work over ip
